text: Implement the frozen v1 estimand as the nonnegative canonical root: maximize w' H w / w' E_lambda w subject to w >= 0 and E_lambda normalization. ScalaFIM owns the typed ConstraintTerm, fold semantics, and stationary-point guarantee; Gale owns the reusable projected-Rayleigh kernel and numerical certificates. The broad all-family variational execution motes remain valuable roadmap extensions but are not architectural prerequisites for this direct typed vertical slice.
